project_type: React 19 SPA CRM (EaseMyOffice) using TanStack Start/Router, Supabase, Cloudflare Workers
build_system: bun (package manager). Vite-based TanStack Start build.
test_framework: None discovered for these UI files; verification is by code inspection + CI.
build_command: bun run build (CANNOT run in sandbox - bun install fails with npm 403 under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY)
test_command: bun run lint / bun run typecheck (CANNOT run in sandbox)
verification_instructions: In-sandbox verification is limited to careful code inspection and consistency with existing patterns. bun install FAILS (npm 403). Build/lint/typecheck/dev server cannot run. CI must validate typecheck/lint/build after push.
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/sandbox/Easemyoffice. Feature branch feat/quotation-multistate-and-sidebar already created off latest origin/main. No install possible in sandbox.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. bun install fails (npm 403). No build/lint/typecheck/dev server. Verify via inspection only. Do NOT push or open PRs - orchestrator publishes.
contribution_requirements: Match existing code style. Use existing UI primitives in src/components/ui (Checkbox, Popover, Command, Select all exist). Email template uses inline styles only (email-safe, tables). Commit all four tasks on the single feature branch.
key_patterns: Email HTML built by buildQuotationHtml() with fully inline styles and role=presentation tables (Gmail/Outlook safe). Pricing table rows built via plans.map in buildQuotationHtml (pricingRows) AND rendered in the React editor form (filteredPlans.slice(0,10).map). Plans come from getSheetPlans() -> PlanRow[]. State/city are single-select via shadcn Select. priceOverrides keyed by plan index. locationLabel derived from selectedCity/selectedState. Sidebar is an <aside className='hidden lg:flex w-64 shrink-0 flex-col ...'> with an inner <nav className='flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 ...'>. Layout wrapper _authenticated.tsx uses 'min-h-screen flex bg-background' with <main className='flex-1 min-w-0 pb-20 lg:pb-0'>.
relevant_files: src/components/send-quotation-dialog.tsx (Tasks 1, 2, 3 - the whole dialog: buildQuotationHtml, SendQuotationDialog component, filtering, pricing table, send flow)
src/components/app-shell.tsx (Task 4 - AppSidebar aside, and MobileTabBar which must not break)
src/lib/bookings-sheet.ts (PlanRow type + getSheetPlans, read for fields: state, city, area, sp_name, code, selling_price, gst_pct, service_type)
src/components/ui/checkbox.tsx, popover.tsx, command.tsx, select.tsx (existing primitives for multi-select)
directory_structure: src/components (feature components + ui/ shadcn primitives), src/routes (TanStack file routes incl _authenticated.tsx layout), src/lib (helpers incl bookings-sheet.ts, email-signature.ts, auth.ts), src/integrations/supabase (client). Email is sent via supabase.functions.invoke('send-client-email').
